# apple_app_store_version_experiment_treatment (Resource)

Adds a treatment to a product page optimization experiment: an alternative version of the product page. An experiment has up to three. A treatment shows the original icon, screenshots and previews unless it has its own: an alternate app icon from the app's binary, or placements on an `apple_app_store_version_experiment_treatment_localization`. A treatment can't change once its experiment has started. Destroying the resource deletes the treatment. Import it by ID.

## Example Usage

```terraform
resource "apple_app_store_version_experiment_treatment" "orange" {
  experiment_id = apple_app_store_version_experiment.icons.id
  name          = "Orange icon"
  app_icon_name = "OrangeIcon"
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `experiment_id` (String) App Store Connect ID of the experiment, e.g. `apple_app_store_version_experiment.example.id`.
- `name` (String) Name of the treatment.

### Optional

- `app_icon_name` (String) Name of an alternate app icon in the app's binary that the treatment shows.

### Read-Only

- `id` (String) App Store Connect ID of the treatment.
- `promoted_date` (String) When the treatment was applied to the product page.

## Import

Import is supported using the following syntax:

In Terraform v1.12.0 and later, the [`import` block](https://developer.hashicorp.com/terraform/language/import) can be used with the `identity` attribute, for example:

```terraform
import {
  to = apple_app_store_version_experiment_treatment.orange
  identity = {
    id = "5d7c1b2a-3e4f-4a5b-9c6d-7e8f9a0b1c2d"
  }
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
### Identity Schema

#### Required

- `id` (String) App Store Connect ID of the treatment.

The [`terraform import` command](https://developer.hashicorp.com/terraform/cli/commands/import) can be used, for example:

```shell
terraform import apple_app_store_version_experiment_treatment.orange 5d7c1b2a-3e4f-4a5b-9c6d-7e8f9a0b1c2d
```
